article: For each question, write the correct answer. How to hold a fun party Are you thinking about holding a party? Then you need to make sure it's lots of fun! Invite plenty (27)…………… people and include a few surprises. For example, if you're serving food, try ordering ten pizzas (28)…………… the same flavour but from different restaurants in your area. Then have a 'taste test' and vote on (29)…………… is best. Or how (30)…………… playing games? You could have a video games tournament and offer prizes for the winners. You could also have a singing competition and ask each guest to sing a song.  If your party includes a meal around a table, for each new course, ask your guests to sit next to someone different, in (31)…………… to talk to as many different people (32)…………… possible. Finally, play fun music: your guests might even get up and dance!

explanations.27:
原因：“plenty of” 固定搭配，“许多人”。
词汇点：plenty of + 可数 / 不可数名词，如 plenty of time/books.
explanations.28:
原因：“ten pizzas of the same flavour”，“相同口味的披萨”。
语法点：of + 抽象名词表属性，如 a man of wisdom（有智慧的人）。
explanations.29:
原因：宾语从句 “which is best”，“哪一个最好”。
语法点：which 引导宾语从句，表选择，如 I don't know which one to choose.
explanations.30:
原因：“how about + 动名词” 表建议，“玩游戏如何”。
语法点：how about doing，如 How about going shopping?
explanations.31:
原因：“in order to” 固定短语，“为了”。
词汇点：in order to do sth.，如 He works hard in order to get a promotion.
explanations.32:
原因：“as many as possible”，“尽可能多”。
语法点：as + adj. + as possible，如 as fast as possible（尽可能快）。
